hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh" ]; then exec bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh"; fi; f=$(ls -d "${HOME}/.claude/plugins/cache"/*/sdlc/*/hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh 2>/dev/null | { sort -Vr 2>/dev/null || sort -r; } | head -1); if [ -n "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; f="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"allow\"}}"'
hooks.description: Enforce declared model tier for SDLC pipeline agents. Reads model: from agent frontmatter and injects the correct model ID via updatedInput before the Agent tool fires. Fails open for unknown agents.
